title: Ensuring Government Web Services and Data Hosted on Commercial Data Centres are Assured of Availability and Data Security
what_it_is: Ensuring Government Web Services and Data Hosted on Commercial Data Centres are Assured of Availability and Data Security

sections.label: Microsoft data centre service degradation
sections.summary: The recent service degradation at a Microsoft data centre had limited impact on Government services, and GovTech is working with Microsoft to restore affected services and prevent similar occurrences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The recent service degradation at a Microsoft data centre had limited impact on Government services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, GovTech has been working with Microsoft to fully restore affected services and prevent similar occurrences in future.

sections.label: Cloud provider procurement criteria
sections.summary: Cloud services providers must meet criteria for availability, resilience and security regardless of ownership and data centre location, and had met the 99.9% availability requirement before this incident.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: To qualify for Government procurement, cloud services providers must meet our criteria for availability, resilience and security.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The same criteria apply regardless of the service provider’s ownership and location of data centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Prior to this incident, cloud service providers had been able to meet our requirement to be available at least 99.9% of the time.

sections.label: 70% Government services on cloud
sections.summary: Plans are only for 70% of Government services to be on cloud providers by 2023, the target is on track, and some services are planned to be controlled directly by the Government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: To be clear, our plans are only for 70% of Government services to be on cloud providers by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are on track to meet that target.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And so, already, we have plans and we have planned for some of our services to be controlled by the Government directly.
